name: cards-demo-1

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows the hovered card with the moving clip, dark scrim and readable text.

tagline: A photo card whose background turns into a moving clip when hovered.
summary: A tall photo card with a bold title and short paragraph pinned to the bottom. Hovering swaps the still fern backdrop for a muted moving clip and adds a dark scrim behind the words.
appearance: A tall portrait card with rounded corners and a dark full-bleed photo, white bold heading "Background Overlays" and a small white paragraph pinned to the bottom left. At rest the photo is a close-up of fern fronds.
behaviour: Hovering replaces the still fern image with a looping clip of a person by a window and lays a dark scrim over it, while the text stays fixed. Leaving returns the fern photo and lifts the scrim.
demo_content: Heading "Background Overlays" and a paragraph about background gifs, over fern and window scenes.
search_phrases: card that plays a video on hover
hover reveals a gif behind text
background video card for a feature
dark card with caption at bottom
use_when: A feature tile should hint at motion only on hover while keeping its copy readable.
avoid_when: Both media files are hardcoded remote URLs, and touch devices never see the hover swap.
customise: Nothing is exposed; the heading, paragraph and both media URLs must be edited directly in the file.
weight_why: One card with a background swap and an overlay scrim; the clip only loads on hover.

a11y.note: Background media is CSS-only with no alt, and the hover swap is unreachable by keyboard or touch.

issues: The hovered clip shows a person, a subject unrelated to the ferns at rest.
The swap happens only on hover, so touch and keyboard users see just the fern.
Background images carry no alt text and the clip ignores reduced-motion.
polish_why: Clean type and a smooth scrim; the unrelated hover clip and plain layout hold it back.
title: Hover Overlay Card
